# T-1: Add approval setup guidance

## Goal
Update the draft-gate procedure so it explicitly tells operators to set or confirm draft approval metadata before running the gate when no unresolved user decision remains.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Pre-gate guidance names `approval.approved` and `approval.confirmedAt`.
- Pre-gate guidance appears before or adjacent to the `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase draft` instruction.
- Guidance says approval metadata setup is allowed only when no unresolved user decision remains.
- `sdd-forge flow get next-action` for draft-gate renders the corrected guidance.

## Implementation Notes
Update the step prompt that owns draft-gate instructions. Do not require generated skill artifacts to inline prompt text. Do not change draft lifecycle validation.

## Test Strategy
Add a spec-local Node test with `// spec: R1 R2 R3` that checks the prompt guidance text, verifies next-action renders the guidance for draft-gate, and checks `DraftApproval` validation behavior.
